sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 800. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Frozen for 40 seconds with a success value of 120.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 170. Prohibits Unison for 40 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Mastery (increases the maximum number of Defense Skills that can activate by 1) for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 150 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Flank for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] ignores 50% of the target's DEF and MDEF; [Special] permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction: Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Stronghold Tactics (increases all stats by 150%, increases max HP by 150%, doubles Unison gauge gains by damage received from enemy players, reduces Unison Attack damage received by 30%) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 50000
Lethargy and Frail Resistance Up by 60

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Serenity for 150 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).

[Aqours] Hanamaru Kunikida or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
